verdict.rationale: Square publishes an official TypeScript/Node SDK in its own GitHub org (square/square-nodejs-sdk), with documented client setup, payment calls, and per-request API version pinning. It also ships a Web Payments SDK, and its llms.txt describes the platform as 'Square APIs and SDKs'. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in other languages (only TypeScript is shown), in-depth SDK reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
